from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingData(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly housing unit authorization figure extracted from a single document."""
    release_id: str | None = Field(description="The document release identifier (e.g., CB22-156)")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the release was published, used to resolve precedence")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data refers to, formatted YYYY-MM")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The number of housing units in thousands")
    status: str | None = Field(description="Whether the value is preliminary or revised")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate all housing data points extracted from the document collection."""
    housing_records: list[MonthlyHousingData]
